source: Pew Research Center. 2009. "Faith in Flux: Changes in Religious Affiliation in the U.S."
method: Population is the subset of respondents who converted TO Mormonism (CURREL2 = 20000), a small subgroup of this 2,867-respondent recontact survey. Each reason's own don't know/refused excluded from its own denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
reason_order: Enjoyed the services and style of worship
Asked to join by a member of the religion
Attracted by a particular minister or pastor
